shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,120p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; printf '\\n--- package.json ---\\n'; cat package.json; printf '\\n--- app ---\\n'; sed -n '1,240p' src/App.tsx; printf '\\n--- main ---\\n'; cat src/main.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "npm install @gravity-ui/dashkit && node -e \"const p=require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/package.json'); console.log(p.version, JSON.stringify(p.peerDependencies))\" && find node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit -maxdepth 3 -iname 'INDEX.md' -o -iname 'README.md' | head"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '220,520p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/docs/INDEX.md; printf '\\n--- dts ---\\n'; rg -n \"type DashKitProps|interface DashKitProps|setItem|removeItem|editMode|onChange|registerPlugins|setSettings|DashKitDnDWrapper\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build -g '*.d.ts' -g '*.js' | head -140"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"export declare const pluginTitle|pluginTitle:|declare const pluginTitle|pluginText\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/plugins -g '*.d.ts'; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/plugins -name '*.d.ts' | head -30; rg -n \"interface TitleProps|interface TextProps\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm -g '*.d.ts' -A15"

/bin/bash -lc 'for f in node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/plugins/Title/Title.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/plugins/Title/types.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/plugins/Title/constants.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/plugins/Text/Text.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/typings/plugin-base.d.ts; do echo ===$f; cat "$f"; done'
/bin/bash -lc "git status --short; git diff --stat; echo '--- App.tsx ---'; cat src/App.tsx; echo '--- Dashboard.tsx ---'; cat src/dashboard/Dashboard.tsx | head -80"
/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"DashKit|import React from 'react'\" src/App.tsx | cat; sed -n '1,40p' src/App.tsx"
/bin/bash -lc "grep -n \"const ChartWidget\\|const itemData\\|const { title\" src/App.tsx | head -10; sed -n '36,46p' src/App.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"const fs=require('fs'); let c=fs.readFileSync('src/App.tsx','utf8'); c=c.replace('</ActionPanel>\\n        </DashKitDnDWrapper>', '</ActionPanel>\\n          </>\\n        </DashKitDnDWrapper>'); fs.writeFileSync('src/App.tsx',c); console.log(c.includes('</>\\n        </DashKitDnDWrapper>'));\""

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"const fs=require('fs'); let c=fs.readFileSync('src/App.tsx','utf8'); c=c.replace('</ActionPanel>', '</ActionPanel>\\n          </>'); fs.writeFileSync('src/App.tsx',c); console.log(c.includes('</ActionPanel>\\n          </>'));\""

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- src/App.tsx ---'; cat src/App.tsx; printf '%s\\n' '--- src/dashboard/widgets.tsx ---'; cat src/dashboard/widgets.tsx; printf '%s\\n' '--- src/dashboard/dashboard.css ---'; cat src/dashboard/dashboard.css; printf '%s\\n' '--- package.json ---'; cat package.json"
/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- src/dashboard/Dashboard.tsx ---'; cat src/dashboard/Dashboard.tsx; printf '%s\\n' '--- src/dashboard/widgets.tsx ---'; cat src/dashboard/widgets.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "apply_patch <<'PATCH' *** Begin Patch *** Update File: src/App.tsx @@
-
- -
- ({ - id: item.id, - title: item.title, - icon: item.icon, - dragProps: { type: item.type }, - }))} - /> + <> +
+ +
+ ({ + id: item.id, + title: item.title, + icon: item.icon, + dragProps: { type: item.type }, + }))} + /> +
*** End Patch PATCH npm run build'
